notes.title: Patch to 4.5.10
notes.content: Fixed the reset on puzzle 'Reach', where one blue block woudn't be reset. My thank to Coder for pointing this out!

notes.title: Patch to version 4.5.9
notes.content:
- Removed four untintended solutions.
- Fixed a buggy interaction between rotators and blue blocks that could occur when rapdily giving inputs.
- Fixed a problem related to the save file slots that could occur if you played the demo version of the game.

Much thanks to everyone who signalled these issues!
